Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.7.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Aura Algorithm Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Core/wiki
Meet Aura (The AI Storyteller!) Aura Algorithm actively monitors the narrative threads of your colony. She does not just throw random events at you; she watches your choices, evaluates the psychological state of your pawns, and crafts bespoke scenarios and quests to test your morals and sanity. Her threat scaling uses traditional colony wealth as a baseline logical cost-benefit analysis, but the frequency and type of threats are dynamically orchestrated.
NOTE: Aura requires an active LLM connection to orchestrate her narrative intelligence. If the LLM becomes disconnected or unresponsive, her storytelling logic will automatically fall back to Classic Cassandra.
--- Roadmap --- 0.8 - Demographics, News and Narrative Voice: Aura's own personality - moving aspect-checking out of hardcoded C# into prompt-driven tool direction, so the narrative voice reasons instead of following fixed rules. 0.9 - Factions and Living Societies: Aura narrating faction and ideological events as they unfold. 0.10 - Cross-Mod Capability Passes: Another pass over Aura's voice across every module's events. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog (v0.7.0) - Regions and Territories Compatibility --- - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.7.0. - Requires Core v0.7.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged.
Full version history: https://github.com/RimSynapse/AuraAlgorithm/wiki/Changelog
